subject.title: [Feature]: Make detached longwork final delivery ownership explicit

question: Should this issue remain the canonical design thread for detached longwork final-delivery ownership, and should the permanent contract be an owner-mode API, a durable delivery-obligation substrate, or narrower per-surface fixes?
rationale: Source inspection shows the missing contract, but the choice changes public routing semantics, persisted state, plugin visibility, and message-delivery defaults; code review cannot safely choose that product/API direction.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Choose Substrate
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design thread and pick the existing subagent/outbound delivery substrate that should own durable final-delivery obligations before implementation.

options.title: Re-cut Owner-Mode API
options.body: Sponsor a smaller replacement for the closed completionOwner PR with explicit modes, docs, compatibility defaults, and live channel proof.

options.title: Split To Narrower Issues
options.body: Move the invariant into narrower Slack, plugin-runtime, and background-work issues if maintainers do not want one shared core contract.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Choose Substrate
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design thread and pick the existing subagent/outbound delivery substrate that should own durable final-delivery obligations before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main and related-issue history is around subagent completion handoff, delivery state, and API/default decisions.
